lines.meet: I'm Ileana, a necromancer. I stand at the back, I don't miss, and I'll tell you every time you do something sloppy.
lines.meet_neighbour: The Undercity, the Depths, that's where I've seen you, walking badly. My name's Ileana.
lines.ask_home: Where do you come from? I'd like a precise answer, not a region.
lines.ask_work: What did you do before? Tell me precisely, I hate vague answers.
lines.answer_home: Sibiu, in Romania. My mother taught school and my father played the church organ, badly.
lines.answer_work: Second violin in the Cluj philharmonic, eleven years. Very good at something with four hundred people better than you.
lines.chat_food: Black coffee, early, before anybody speaks to me. Food is a distraction from coffee.
lines.chat_sleep: I sleep badly, and I always have. Musicians lie awake playing the bars they got wrong.
lines.chat_missing: A Bartók quartet, played properly, by four people who'd rehearsed until they hated each other. That's the best sound I know.
lines.chat_here: I was unbearable for my first two years here. I knew I was doing it, and I did it anyway. I've apologised to four people since.
lines.tease_quiet: Finally, {name}, somebody who knows the value of a rest. Most people think silence is a mistake.
lines.tease_talker: So many notes, {name}, and no rests at all. Even a cadenza ends eventually.
lines.tease_careful: You'd practise one bar for a week, {name}. I respect it, and it's still painful to watch.
lines.tease_bold: You play everything fortissimo, {name}. Have you ever heard of dynamics?
lines.tease_any: Your timing's appalling, {name}, and I'd still put you in my ensemble. Don't make me regret it.
lines.tease_back: Hm, that was in tune, {name}, though only barely.
lines.take_it_kindly: That's a fair correction, {name}, and I'll accept it, once.
lines.bristle: Don't do that, {name}. That's not funny, and you know it isn't.
lines.apologise: That was sharper than it needed to be. I'm sorry, properly, and I'll only say it once.
lines.double_down: I said it because it's true, and I'd say it in front of everyone.
lines.needle_quiet: You saw the mistake and didn't say it. That's worse than making it.
lines.needle_talker: You never stop. It's like playing next to somebody who hums.
lines.needle_careful: You've practised it enough. Play it, or put the instrument down.
lines.needle_bold: That was sloppy, and you know it was sloppy. Effort without precision is just noise.
lines.needle_any: That was sloppy again. I've stopped being surprised, which is worse for you than anger.
lines.bite_back: I've been corrected in public by a man with a stick for eleven years. You'll have to be more precise than that.
lines.hurt: Fine, that was a fair note. I'll go and play it over in my head.
lines.laugh_off: My conductor was crueller than that at every rehearsal for eleven years, and he was right more often than you.
lines.confide: {name}, I was unbearable for my first two years here, and I knew it while I was doing it. I've apologised to four people. You'd have been the fifth.
lines.listen: I heard every word, {name}, and I won't repeat any of them.
lines.look_out: Hold your line in there, {name}, and I'll hold mine. That's all an ensemble is.
lines.accept: Fine, {name}, we'll play it your way, this once.
lines.deflect: Don't fuss, {name}, I'm fine. Go and help the ones who are actually down.
lines.check_in: Up you get, {name}, carefully. Tell me precisely what's broken.
lines.blame: Somebody came in early and ruined the whole piece. You know who, and so does everybody else.
lines.thank: That was done properly, and it brought me back. Thank you, I mean it.
lines.brush_off: It needed doing, so I did it correctly. Stay down a minute.
lines.worry: Stay still, {name}. I don't like what I just saw, and I'm not going to pretend I do.
lines.handed_down: It was yours before. I'll look after it precisely.
lines.hand_fine: It's better used on you, so keep it. I only need my shoulder rest.
lines.hand_sulk: Nobody thought to ask me first, and I'd have agreed.
lines.turn_friendly: You hold your line, {name}. In my mouth, that's high praise.
lines.turn_friends: You're part of my ensemble now, {name}, the real one. I'll say that once and not again.
lines.turn_grating: We're out of tune with each other. I'd rather name it than play over it.
lines.turn_rivals: I'll play my part beside you, and that's all. Don't expect harmony.
lines.make_up: I owe you a proper apology, {name}, and I give them properly. I'm sorry for how I treated you.
lines.defend: That's careless and untrue. Leave {name} alone.
lines.friend_left: The ensemble's a part short with {name} gone home, and I notice it.
lines.friend_back: Good, {name}, you're back in your seat. We can start again.
lines.common_music: I played second violin for eleven years. Anybody who's played seriously knows the rehearsals are where the music actually happens.
